subject: MSstat used for single experimental condition Quantification

messages.author: bafd645ae6a3484b
messages.subject: MSstat used for single experimental condition Quantification
parts:
Good day 

Can MSstat be used (in Skyline) to quantify a single sample's proteins or even 'n single experimental condition with replicates? How would this be done?

Kind regards
Melissa

messages.author: 99540594784b9805
messages.subject: Re: MSstat used for single experimental condition Quantification
parts:
I don't think there is any way of getting those numbers from the output that you get when you use the MSstats external tool in Skyline.
If you are invoking MSstats in R yourself, then those protein abundances will be in the Data Frame which is returned by the "dataProcess" call.

Skyline has its own way of calculating protein abundances, and you can see the protein abundance values in the Document Grid in a column called "Protein Abundance".
If you would like to learn more about the Document Grid in Skyline you can take a look at the Custom Reports tutorial:
https://skyline.ms/wiki/home/software/Skyline/page.view?name=tutorial_custom_reports

-- Nick
